info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Consumer Features
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Consumer Features.** The embedded consumer app — goals, follows, bookmarks, discovery, geo search and sync with the Context Directory.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND)

message.description: Human-readable message; validation errors return one message per violation

path.description: Request path that produced the error

requestId.description: Correlation ID (echoes the X-Request-Id header) for support and log lookup

goalId.description: Goal ID from the user portfolio (optional for all-goals/random)

contentQueries.description: Resolved content_queries from goal definition (with substituted params)

randomSeed.description: Seed for random mode (same seed = same order within session)

podBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Content Pod

params.description: Query params for GET or body for POST

contentType.description: Content type of the source teaser

publisherId.description: Publisher ID of the source teaser

excludeId.description: Teaser ID to exclude from results

nodeUrl.description: Target Discovery Node URL (omit for federated)
